title: Factors & Multiples
description: Class 5 IMO — Factors & multiples: prime factorization with factor trees, HCF and LCM by the prime factorization method, divisibility rules for 4, 6, 8, 9 and 11, and word problems.

topics.title: Prime Factorization
topics.concept:
Prime factorization means writing a number as a product of prime numbers. A factor tree helps: keep splitting a number into factors until only primes are left.

For 12: 12 = 2 × 6 = 2 × 2 × 3. So the prime factorization of 12 is 2 × 2 × 3.
recap: Prime factorization = a number written as a product of primes.
Use a factor tree, splitting until only primes remain.

quiz.q: What is the prime factorization of 20?
Which is the prime factorization of 30?

topics.title: HCF & LCM by Prime Factorization
topics.concept:
Write each number as a product of primes. The HCF is the product of the common prime factors; the LCM is the product of all prime factors, taking the highest power of each.

For 12 = 2² × 3 and 18 = 2 × 3²: HCF = 2 × 3 = 6 and LCM = 2² × 3² = 36.
recap: HCF = product of common prime factors.
LCM = product of all primes, using the highest power of each.

quiz.q: What is the HCF of 8 and 12?
What is the LCM of 6 and 8?

topics.title: Divisibility Rules
topics.concept: Quick checks: a number is divisible by 4 if its last two digits form a number divisible by 4, by 8 if its last three digits do, by 6 if it is divisible by both 2 and 3, by 9 if the digit sum is divisible by 9, and by 11 if the difference of alternate digit sums is 0 or a multiple of 11.

examples.solution: The last two digits 32 ÷ 4 = 8, so yes.
Digit sum 1 + 2 + 6 = 9, which is divisible by 9, so yes.

recap: By 4: last two digits; by 8: last three digits.
By 6: divisible by 2 and 3; by 9: digit sum divisible by 9.

quiz.explanation: Digit sum 1 + 5 + 3 = 9, which is divisible by 9, so yes.

questions.q: Which is the odd one out (three are prime numbers)?
questions.explanation: 15 = 3 × 5 is composite; the others are prime.

questions.q: Which is the prime factorization of 12?

questions.explanation: Digit sum of 108 is 1 + 0 + 8 = 9, divisible by 9.

questions.q: The HCF of two numbers is the product of their ___ prime factors.
questions.explanation: HCF uses the common prime factors.

questions.q: What is the prime factorization of 24?
What is the HCF of 12 and 18?
What is the LCM of 6 and 8?
Two ropes of 12 m and 16 m are cut into equal pieces of the greatest length. What is that length?
questions.explanation: Greatest length = HCF of 12 and 16 = 4 m.

questions.q: Two lights blink every 6 seconds and 8 seconds. After how many seconds do they blink together?
questions.explanation: They blink together at the LCM of 6 and 8, which is 24 seconds.

questions.q: 36 apples and 24 oranges are packed into boxes with equal numbers of each, using the largest box size. How many fruits of each go in a box?
questions.explanation: Largest equal box size = HCF of 36 and 24 = 12.
